text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r a-s-s-e-m-b-l-e-d a f-a-k-e p-r-o-f-i-l-e u-s-i-n-g s-t-o-l-e-n i-m-a-g-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e d-i-g-i-t-a-l i-d, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n o-f t-h-e s-o-u-r-c-e s-i-t-e.
2) the a-c-t-o-r d-r-a-f-t-e-d a l-o-n-g s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e o-f a-f-f-e-c-t-i-o-n a-t-e m-e-s-s-a-g-e-s t-o b-u-i-l-d t-r-u-s-t, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a s-a-v-e-d t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e f-i-l-e, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a r-e-v-i-e-w f-o-r d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e.
3) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-q-u-e-s-t-e-d u-r-g-e-n-t f-u-n-d-s f-o-r a p-r-e-t-e-x-t c-r-i-s-i-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r l-o-g, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a c-l-e-a-r a-n-s-w-e-r o-n t-h-e v-i-c-t-i-m's f-i-n-a-n-c-i-a-l s-t-a-t-u-s.
4) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-c-r-u-i-t-e-d t-h-i-r-d p-a-r-t-i-e-s a-s m-o-n-e-y m-u-l-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a c-h-a-i-n o-f d-e-p-o-s-i-t a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g i-d-e-n-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n o-f t-h-e a-c-t-u-a-l b-e-n-e-f-i-c-i-a-r-y.
5) the a-c-t-o-r i-s-s-u-e-d w-a-r-n-i-n-g-s a-g-a-i-n-s-t r-e-p-o-r-t-i-n-g, l-e-a-v-i-n-g i-n-t-i-m-i-d-a-t-e-d v-i-c-t-i-m s-t-a-t-e-m-e-n-t-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a-c-k-n-o-w-l-e-d-g-i-n-g t-h-e l-a-w-f-u-l r-i-g-h-t t-o c-o-o-p-e-r-a-t-e w-i-t-h p-o-l-i-c-e.
